text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Gosh! Do they ever shut up? The
audience is way
too loud, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar! Go out there and settle them
down! Or
better yet, just tell them all to
shut it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Just tell them Magical Girl Sweepy's
gonna crush
it out there, whether they
scream or not.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nothing can stand up to a super genius's
magic,
so all they need to do is sit
quietly and watch!
